notes: BACKEND_BASE_URL uses host.docker.internal so the toolkit container can reach
the FastAPI backend running on the host. When running the toolkit natively
with 'npm start' instead of Docker, change it to http://localhost:8000.
BACKEND_API_KEY must match the API_KEY the backend was started with.
If WEBHOOK_SECRET is set on the backend, webhook signature verification is
enabled and the toolkit cannot sign requests - leave WEBHOOK_SECRET unset
while driving the backend from the toolkit.
